all.name: Moon Knight
all.description: As the avatar of the Egyptian God of Vengeance, Marc Spector's body has been enhanced by Khonshu himself. Bathed in a luminous aura that pierces the darkness, Moon Knight glides through the night, ready to sear his enemies with his master's sacred Ankhs.

item.name: Triple Eclipse
item.description: Perform a combo with his truncheon, and the third strike will slightly <Debuff>Launch Up</> enemies.

item.name: Crescent Dart
item.description: Unleash Crescent Darts forward that can bounce between enemies and <Orange>Ankhs</>, dealing damage to enemies.

additional_fields.Casting: Triple shot that fires in a straight trajectory
additional_fields.Fire_Rate: The firing interval between shots is 0.05s, with an interval of 0.57s between each round of shooting
additional_fields.Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 30m, decreasing to 50% at 50m

item.name: Crescent Dart
item.description: Unleash Crescent Darts forward that can bounce between enemies and <Orange>Ankhs</>, dealing damage to enemies.

additional_fields.Casting: Triple shot that fires in a straight trajectory
additional_fields.Fire_Rate: The firing interval between shots is 0.05s, with an interval of 0.57s between each round of shooting
additional_fields.Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 30m, decreasing to 50% at 50m

item.name: Moon Blade
item.description: Launch forward a Moon Blade that can bounce between enemies and <Orange>Ankhs</>, dealing damage to enemies while granting you <Buff>Bonus Health</>.

additional_fields.Casting: Projectile that fires in a straight trajectory
additional_fields.Bonus_Health: 25, up to a max of 76 Bonus Health
additional_fields.Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 30m, decreasing to 50% at 50m

item.name: Ancient Ankh
item.description: Fire an <Orange>Ankh</> to <Debuff>Knock</> enemies within its radius airborne towards the center.

additional_fields.Casting: Straight-line projectile that generates a spell field upon impact

item.name: Moonlight Hook
item.description: Launch a frontal grappling hook that pulls Moon Knight towards it.

item.name: Hand Of Khonshu
item.description: Open a portal that allows Khonshu to bombard enemies with his talons.

item.name: Moon God's Chosen
item.description: Blessed by Khonshu, Blade gains a new ability. When activated, Blade swings his <Orange>Ancestral Sword</> in a powerful slash, dashing forward a short distance. At the end of the dash, he swiftly slashes four times, each strike sending a <Orange>Darkmoon Blade</> forward. When a <Orange>Darkmoon Blade</> hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets.
